evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 405.434 °C, markedly above the other column temperatures (42.652–59.339 °C).

T701 has risen to 412.739 °C while T702 is 60.357 °C, T704 55.234 °C, T706 55.284 °C, and T712 43.660 °C; the persistent isolated high reading warrants verification, but does not establish thermocouple drift rather than actual overheating.
System pressure is 199.408 mbar, pressure differences are -0.076 and 1.821 mbar, and both level switches remain 1; these channels do not independently explain the high T701 reading.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration check, and protocol temperature limits/heater settings are needed to distinguish a measurement fault from actual overheating. No composition measurement or separation target is provided; reflux and distillate flow sensors are not installed.
